text:
ama_cust: Hey team — following the midnight model push, our assistant responses got... different. They're much more clipped and skip follow-up steps. Not sure if this is a tuning change or a bug.

jess_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a couple of before/after examples? Also which API host/region and model id?

ama_cust: Sure. We called the same prompt twice (timestamps included). Before (two days ago):

```
User: How do I link Stripe for billing?
Assistant: To connect Stripe: 1) Go to Settings > Billing. 2) Click "Connect Stripe" and follow the OAuth flow. 3) Confirm webhook URL and enable events. If you want, I can give you the exact webhook config.
```

After (last night):

```
User: How do I link Stripe for billing?
Assistant: Go to Settings > Billing and connect Stripe.
```

ama_cust: The second reply is missing the step-by-step and the offer to provide webhook details. It feels... clipped. Customers are now opening support tickets.

jess_support: Thanks. Can you send the request ids or x-request-id headers for the later calls? Also which model revision did you get in the response (model: redwood-v2.4)?

ama_cust: I grabbed a request id: req_7b3f2a11. Model header says: redwood-rt:v2.4-2026-03-15

leo_engineer: pinging eng-ml — this looks like an output verbosity regression. Did the rollout change decoding defaults or system prompt?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for redwood-rt:v2.4-2026-03-15 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-15T02:13:00Z

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 50% at 2026-03-15T02:45:00Z

mike_sre: We saw a small bump in median token-per-response for a subset (down from 42 tokens to 28 tokens) around 02:30 UTC for EU region.

leo_engineer: Interesting — token count dropped. Did Optimize change batching/penalty defaults? Any changes to sampling temperature or top_p?

eng-ml (via leo_engineer): We pushed a micro-tune that added a length penalty and a slight decrease in temperature to tighten hallucination. Might be overly aggressive for customer prompts.

jess_support: For repro steps, can you run this curl against prod and include the full response headers and body? (replace API_KEY)

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt:v2.4-2026-03-15","input":"How do I link Stripe for billing?","max_tokens":150}'
```

jess_support: Also please set X-Request-Id and include the response-model header.

ama_cust: Running now — I get body with assistant text that's short. Request id: req_7b3f2a11. Response header: response-model: redwood-rt:v2.4-2026-03-15

leo_engineer: Got the logs. Reproduced locally with the same model variant; length penalty parameter was set to 1.2 for the rollout. We can test reverting to 0.6 and re-canary.

mike_sre: Recommend rolling canary back to 10% and coordinate customer-facing message. SLA impact minimal but UX impacted.

jess_support: I'll tell the customer we have a suspected verbosity parameter change and we're testing a rollback. AMA, would you be open to us routing your traffic to older revision while we fix?

ama_cust: Yes please, routing to prior revision would be ideal until you confirm. Thanks.

leo_engineer: Escalating to eng-ml priority P1. Creating internal ticket INF-2026-412. Action: rollback length-penalty change on canary and re-evaluate metrics and a short A/B on sample prompts (including customer's examples).

jess_support: Noted. I'll follow up with the customer once rollback is in place and share repro steps. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: Rolling rollback scheduled in 5m. Will post updates.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for redwood-rt:v2.4-2026-03-15 -> revert length-penalty at 2026-03-15T03:10:00Z

mike_sre: Rollback completed. Post-rollback median token count for EU restored to ~40.

jess_support: AMA — can you confirm the assistant output now? If it's back to expected, we'll close the loop.

ama_cust: Confirmed — replies restored to longer, stepwise answers. Thanks for the fast turnaround!

jess_support: Closing here but INF-2026-412 will track follow-up (tune windows and automated regressions alerts).
